svg.title: The loop your AI agent runs with analysis-video
svg.desc: Three lanes: you, your AI agent, and analysis-video. You ask a question; the agent runs analyze, receives context.md plus a next object carrying the image cost, reads and writes the analysis itself, then stores it with review. The tool never calls a model.
